_meta.name: credential-registry
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable CATALOGUE of known providers and the exact env var name(s) each one needs. Read by scripts/preflight-credentials.mjs to scope the credential gate to the locked run_state path.
_meta.IMPORTANT_this_is_a_catalogue_not_a_stac: Listing a provider here does NOT mean FNNL Agency uses it. This file answers 'if you chose tool X, which env vars does it need'. WHICH tools FNNL actually uses is declared ONLY in outbound/stack-contract.yaml. As of 2026-09-22 (operator directive) that is SIX tools, recorded in the contract's approved_stack block: GetLeads, AI Ark, Prospeo, Giggal, Clay and PlusVibe (Giggal replaced MillionVerifier on 2026-10-12). Every other provider here is a catalogue entry only, and under approved_stack rule 2 it is never credentialed or spent on without explicit operator approval. Never infer FNNL's stack from this catalogue.
_meta.how_to_use: /stack-setup records the chosen tool in stack-contract.yaml, then copies that provider's env var names from here into .env.example. A provider present here but absent from the contract is simply a tool FNNL has not chosen.
_meta.ownership_split: This registry + preflight own credential PRESENCE + SHAPE. /api-cost-governance owns BALANCE + SPEND. Shared registry, no duplicated logic.
_meta.secret_hygiene: Names + shapes only. NEVER stores or echoes a secret value. The preflight prints only present/MISSING/malformed or a masked last-4 tail.
_meta.provenance: Env var names were verified against a working upstream workspace. They are believed correct but have NOT been verified against FNNL's own accounts or plan tiers. Confirm on first real call. UPDATED 2026-09-18 by /stack-setup: added plusvibe, scaledmail, ai_ark, getleads, parallel and heyreach for FNNL's chosen stack, added the 'channel' tier and the dynadot_scaledmail pairing, and added DYNADOT_API_SECRET for Dynadot's REST v2 request signing. These six new entries were written from VENDOR DOCUMENTATION on 2026-09-18 and have NOT been verified against FNNL's own accounts. Confirm on first real call. UPDATED 2026-10-12: added giggal as the email verifier of record (GIGGAL_API_KEY), replacing millionverifier, which is now a catalogue alternative at tier 'source'. UPDATED AGAIN 2026-09-18: added clay (list workbench), promoted leadmagic to FNNL's verifier of record at tier 'always', and CORRECTED leadmagic's catch-all claim, which described a removed legacy API. Retiered six providers (millionverifier, bounceban, reoon, deliverable, enrichly, bettercontact) off tier 'always' so preflight stops demanding keys for tools FNNL does not use.
_meta.approved_stack_2026_09_22: The six approved tools carry trigger {always: true} so /preflight-credentials checks every one of them on every run: ai_ark, prospeo, giggal, clay and getleads directly, plusvibe through the sending_platform slot. All are enforcement 'warn' except plusvibe ('fail', inherited from the platform tier), because none is `live` yet. Promote a tool to 'fail' only once its slot in stack-contract.yaml is `live`. LeadMagic lost the 'always' trigger when MillionVerifier replaced it, and MillionVerifier lost it when Giggal replaced it (2026-10-12).
_meta.no_ai_api_rule_2026_09_22: Operator directive 2026-09-22: the only AI is Claude Code itself (the session, its sub-agents, the /deep-research harness, and its built-in WebSearch/WebFetch). REMOVED from this catalogue as retired AI-provider entries: claude (CLAUDE_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), deepseek (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY), perplexity (PERPLEXITY_API_KEY), grok (XAI_API_KEY / GROK_API_KEY), minimax (MINIMAX_API_KEY) and parallel (PARALLEL_API_KEY). Do not re-add them. The research_primary flag went with the perplexity entry, so no key is ever elevated to REQUIRED by research routing: run_state.research_routing has one value, claude_deep_research, which needs no key. The 'ai-optional' tier is retired (no entry uses it). serper and spider (third-party web search / crawl) moved to tier 'source' with a source_id trigger, because web access is now Claude Code's WebSearch/WebFetch. competitor_engagers lost OPENROUTER_API_KEY (an LLM API). THE ONE EXCEPTION: openai (OPENAI_API_KEY), OpenAI, headshots only, asked for at infrastructure setup. It sits in tier 'on-demand' with a trigger /preflight-credentials never selects, so it is never requested or flagged missing at onboarding, intake, kickoff, preflight, stack setup or workspace creation.

tiers.always: Needed by every send flow. Default enforcement: fail (overridable per provider).
tiers.stack-registrar: Required by run_state.registrar. Default enforcement: fail.
tiers.stack-mailbox: Required by run_state.mailbox_provider. Default enforcement: fail.
tiers.platform: Required by run_state.sending_platform. Default enforcement: fail.
tiers.crm: CRM sync tool, only when a CRM is set in the stack contract. Default enforcement: warn (optional layer).
tiers.source: Lead-source tool key, only when that source is the recorded choice. Default enforcement: warn.
tiers.channel: Non-email outbound channel (LinkedIn). Only required when a client's campaign actually runs that channel. Default enforcement: warn.
tiers.on-demand: Requested only when one specific step runs, never at onboarding, intake, kickoff, preflight, stack setup or workspace creation. /preflight-credentials never selects these entries (their trigger has no always, source_id or slot field). Today only openai: OPENAI_API_KEY, headshots only, asked for at infrastructure setup. (Replaces the retired 'ai-optional' tier, no-AI-API rule 2026-09-22.)

giggal.label: Giggal (email verifier of record)
giggal.enforcement_reason: In FNNL's approved six (stack-contract.yaml approved_stack, operator directive 2026-10-12, replacing MillionVerifier). Warn-only until the slot is `live` in the contract; promote to 'fail' then.
giggal.note: FNNL'S EMAIL VERIFIER OF RECORD from 2026-10-12 (operator directive; stack-contract.yaml lead_data.email_verification), REPLACING MillionVerifier. Runs between every stage of the enrichment waterfall. REST https://api.giggal.ai/v1, Bearer header only, replies {success, data, meta}. Per-address status deliverable | undeliverable | unknown | accept_all (risky) with a 0-100 score. accept_all and risky go to the catch_all gate and are resolved by POST /catchall (1 credit per catch-all address in the source job, run once per batch). Reached through the local MCP server outbound/scripts/mcp/giggal_mcp.mjs (registered in .mcp.json as 'giggal'), which reads GIGGAL_API_KEY from scripts/.env itself, and through scripts/giggal_verify.mjs for whole CSVs (batching, 90 day cache, gate mapping). A hosted MCP also exists (https://mcp.giggal.ai/mcp, OpenMausBot entry giggal-fnnl-agency, Bearer header). Set the key with scripts/setup-giggal-key.ps1. Key shape tp_live_. PROVEN 2026-10-12 on FNNL's own key: live single verify, live batch with the catch-all path, GET /credits (free). 1 credit per verification, unknown is refunded. Limits: 300 requests / 15 min, 30 batch creations / 15 min, results kept 48 hours. First live proof of the slot: giggal_get_credits (free).

leadmagic.label: LeadMagic (email verifier + finder + enricher; NOT in FNNL stack)
leadmagic.note: REPLACED FOR FNNL 2026-09-22 by MillionVerifier and then 2026-10-12 by Giggal (operator directives). Kept as a catalogue alternative. Research from its time as verifier of record follows. CORRECTED 2026-09-18. The previous note in this file was WRONG: it claimed /email-validate returns email_status plus a separate is_domain_catch_all boolean. That described LeadMagic's LEGACY API. BOTH ARE GONE. Verified by downloading LeadMagic's official OpenAPI 3.1 spec and grepping all 323,658 bytes for 'catch': ZERO matches. CURRENT: POST https://api.leadmagic.io/v1/people/email-validation , auth header X-API-Key, body {"email": "..."}. email_status values are ONLY valid | invalid | unknown. Catch-all domains return `unknown` and are FREE. There is NO catch-all flag and NO catch-all status. CONSEQUENCE FOR FNNL: LeadMagic does NOT inflate bounce rate (it errs conservative), but `unknown` is a three-way overload (catch-all, unreachable server, inconclusive SMTP) with no discriminator, so /email-waterfall's Catch-All Timing gate CANNOT run on its output and catch-alls get DROPPED rather than held for domain maturity. That is lost addressable volume. AI Ark's reveal-time CATCH_ALL label is the only catch-all signal left in the stack: preserve it as a column. COST: 0.25 credits/validation, INVALID BILLS, UNKNOWN IS FREE. Plans 49.99 to 849 USD/mo. Async bulk via POST /bulk/submit, with /v1/batch/preview-cost and /v1/batch/budgets for hard credit ceilings. Rate limit 600 req/min, ~10 req/s burst. Free tier 100 credits, no card. Official HOSTED MCP at https://mcp.leadmagic.io/mcp (OAuth, no key); the older local npx server is DEPRECATED and is the one still carrying the stale is_domain_catch_all type. Native Clay integration with bring-your-own-key confirmed. 81 endpoints total (finder, mobile, LinkedIn-to-email both ways, job-change detection, technographics).
leadmagic.enforcement_reason: Not in FNNL's approved stack since 2026-09-22: MillionVerifier, then Giggal (2026-10-12), replaced it as verifier of record. Warn-only; checked only if a run names it as its source.

clay.label: Clay (lead-list workbench / sheet view)
clay.note: IN FNNL'S APPROVED SIX (2026-09-22). FNNL'S LEAD-LIST WORKBENCH (stack-contract.yaml lead_data.list_workbench, operator directive 2026-09-18). Clay is the FRAME, not the data vendor: FNNL's own tools enrich through it. ZERO CLAY CREDITS, EVER (HARD RULE 2026-09-22, stack-contract.yaml lead_data.list_workbench.credit_policy_rule), enforced for Claude Code by .claude/hooks/clay-credit-guard.mjs. WORKSPACE: Dorsia Labs (ID 651677), operator-confirmed 2026-09-22. Never build a client list in a-sales.co (ID 161971), the previous company's workspace. THE MCP IS THE WRONG SURFACE for table work, verified against the live tool manifest: no create-table, add-column, read-rows or update-cell, and its subroutines spend CLAY's own credits. Use the INBOUND WEBHOOK to push rows (zero Actions) and the Routines API (POST /routines/{id}/run). REST base https://api.clay.com/public/v0 , header clay-api-key. TWO METERS: Actions (platform orchestration) bill SEPARATELY from Data Credits (vendor data). Bring-your-own-key removes Data Credits but NOT Actions; Clay's own words: 'an Action will still be consumed'. Nothing inside Clay enriches for free, including the HTTP API column. Webhook import, viewing, manual editing, formulas, filters and CSV export DO cost zero Actions, which is why the cheap architecture runs enrichment in FNNL's own scripts and POSTs finished rows in. LeadMagic (5 actions) and Prospeo (3 actions) are NATIVE with BYOK. AI ARK IS NOT NATIVE and needs an HTTP API column, which forces Clay's GROWTH plan (~446 USD/mo). READ-BACK GAP: below ENTERPRISE there is no general read-current-table call (public-API Tables are read-only AND Enterprise-gated), so an agent can write rows in but cannot read back the sheet after human edits. Clay is a human-in-the-loop REVIEW LAYER here, not an unattended agent workbench.
